$comment: Activity markers: where each side activity shows on the minimap, per district (docs/design.md, Side activities and Territory). Every active district has at least one marker of a wave-2 activity (tests/content/territory-coverage.test.ts). Positions are street locations; car washes and kiosks are unnamed icons. The Sim-Player track may snap kiosks and car washes to the pipeline's anchor points.
source: Hand-placed from DataSF street-centerline intersections (3psu-pn9h); approximate.

activities.name: Hot Desk
activities.note: Mission 1 starts at the Ferry Building plaza; the first melt lands within 90 s.

activities.name: Spill
activities.note: Mission 2: a crew of three on the Embarcadero by Mission St.

activities.name: Market stall queue
activities.note: Footmen queue at the Ferry Building market stalls (icons only); queue-jumpers post here.
